title: The Portrait of Marrow Creek
author: Zephyrine Marchetti
blurb: Ivo Lockridge, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must get the family out ahead of the count before the well refills.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
